integrity.computational_role: The checker verifies the new algebraic identities and case split; it does not replace the cited quadratic-length theorem.

scientific_limitations: The field is algebraically closed of characteristic zero.
The result concerns only the subgroup generated by the two extremal quartic normal forms.
The lower bound q=5 for the normalized quartics is imported from arXiv:2609.39943v1 rather than reproved from first principles.
title: A rank-two Cremona subgroup with exact quadratic-length spectrum \(\{0,1,5\}\)
